industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers
name: Good Energy Group PLC
summary: Good Energy Group PLC, through its subsidiaries, engages in the purchase, generation, and sale of electricity from renewable sources in the United Kingdom. The company generates electric power by wind turbine machinery and solar panels. It also sells gas; and provides services related to micro-renewable generation. The company was formerly known as Monkton Group PLC. Good Energy Group PLC was founded in 1999 and is based in Chippenham, the United Kingdom.
